# custom_components/weather_app/ — HACS "Weather App Dashboard" integration

*Generated by index-knowledge · commit 917d399 · branch main. See ../../AGENTS.md for project-wide conventions.*

## OVERVIEW
Companion to the add-on (NOT the add-on itself). Makes the embed turnkey: registers a Lovelace card that iframes the add-on's ingress UI over HA's own HTTPS origin, and auto-creates a panel-mode "Weather" dashboard you CAN set as default (an ingress panel can't be a default dashboard). Python + two frontend JS modules.

## STRUCTURE
```
__init__.py             # setup: register card resource + self-heal module + create dashboard + hide add-on panel
const.py                # DOMAIN, CARD/SELFHEAL urls, DASHBOARD_URL_PATH="weather-wall"
config_flow.py          # single-instance flow, NO fields (just a Submit button)
manifest.json           # domain weather_app; deps: lovelace/frontend/hassio
weather-app-card.js     # iframe embed + ingress session + watchdog (reloads a stuck/errored iframe)
weather-app-selfheal.js # page-level watchdog loaded on EVERY frontend page (recovers when the card never ran)
```

## WHERE TO LOOK
| Task | Location |
|------|----------|
| Card embed / ingress session / watchdog | `weather-app-card.js` |
| "Custom element doesn't exist" recovery | `weather-app-selfheal.js` (2-stage: SPA-bounce soft, then service-worker purge + reload hard) |
| Dashboard create/remove | `__init__.py` `_async_ensure_dashboard` / `_async_remove_dashboard` |
| Hide the add-on's own sidebar panel | `__init__.py` `_async_hide_addon_panel_once` (Supervisor API, once per entry) |
| Cache-bust card updates | `__init__.py` `_card_content_version` (sha256 → `?v=` on the resource URL) |

## CONVENTIONS / GOTCHAS
- **Everything is best-effort/defensive** — a failure here must NEVER break HA setup (broad `except` + `_LOGGER.exception`, once-per-session `hass.data` guards).
- Add-on slug is auto-detected by the `_weather_app` suffix (in both Python and the card JS); pin via the card's `addon:` option if needed.
- The card is registered as a Lovelace **resource** (loads before card render), NOT `add_extra_js_url` (which races a panel's first render) — extra-JS is only the YAML-mode fallback.
- Uses lovelace-INTERNAL imports (`_register_panel`, `DashboardsCollection`) — lazily imported so a future HA reorg fails cleanly (logged, non-fatal).
- Two independent versions in this repo: this `manifest.json` (0.7.1) vs the add-on's `homeassistant/config.yaml`.
- Excluded from the add-on Docker image (see `.dockerignore`).
- Ingress-session handling is adapted from ha-addon-iframe-card (Apache-2.0) — keep the attribution in the card header.
